captions.story: Hundreds of ancient wooden ships sit untouched at the bottom of the Baltic Sea. Here is why they never decay.

story.series: What Lies at the Bottom of the Baltic Sea?
story.summary: This episode explores why wooden shipwrecks at the bottom of the Baltic Sea remain perfectly preserved for hundreds of years due to low salinity and oxygen-deprived dead zones.

title: What Lies at the Bottom of the Baltic Sea?
